_readme: The external community spreadsheet this tracker imports (see
docs/EXTERNAL-SHEET.md). It is imported by the pipeline / GitHub Actions
only — no page ever contacts Google. Everything it says is published as
'spreadsheet imported': an external record of what its editors
`maintainer` is credited on the methodology page. Leave it null until a
human has confirmed who maintains the sheet: the importer also records
any credit text it finds INSIDE the workbook (cells that say 'made by',
'maintained by', 'credits', ...), and the site quotes that text with its
cell reference rather than guessing a name.
label: OWCS community match spreadsheet
creditNote: Match, map, ban and hero-appearance records are imported from a public, community-maintained Google Sheet. All credit for collecting them belongs to its editors; errors introduced by this tracker's import are ours.
